entity.name: Dubai Marina Vertiport
entity.meta_description: Dubai Marina Vertiport is the second node of Dubai's eVTOL network. Confirmed under construction by Skyports Infrastructure as of 16 April 2026, under Joby Aviation's exclusive RTA agreement. Per the RTA the site is within the American University in Dubai parking area — the same facility as the AUD Vertiport entry.
